lines.t: Yeah… mmh
Shalom, shalom
Set-apart time…
From sunset to sunset
Thank Yah it’s Friday, follow me I’m ’bout to spread the Word,
From Friday sunset to Saturday sunset — Shalom heard.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, lay the burdens down tonight,
Step away from the world, walk into the Light.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, don’t let the madness pull you in,
Depart from the ways of the world before you snap, before you bend.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, rest your soul, be still, be free,
Set apart, holy time — just Yah and me.
Why do you depart from the Sabbath at sundown,
Then run back to the world, put the old chains back on?
You shut the door on the noise, on the pride, on the fear,
But welcome it back like it never left here.
Phones keep ringing, minds still racing,
Worries waiting, patience fading.
But He said, Come away and rest,
Put the weight down, pass the test.
No buying, no selling, no chasing the day,
No heavy conversations pulling peace away.
Let your words be clean, let your heart be right,
Walk humbly with your God tonight.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, follow me I’m ’bout to spread the Word,
From Friday sunset to Saturday sunset — Shalom heard.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, let the world fade out of sight,
Kingdom focus, holy rest, truth and light.
On the Sabbath, let no unclean thing come from your mouth,
Let only praise and beauty flow freely out.
Let His grace be your covering, gentle and true,
Let humility walk everywhere you do.
Put away your works, put the worries aside,
For just one day, let Yah provide.
Look at creation, the work of His hand,
He rested too — just as He planned.
Rather treat every day as the Sabbath,
And you will do well…
Rather treat every day as the Sabbath,
So your heart won’t dwell
In the chaos, the pressure, the fear of this age —
Live set apart, not bound by the cage.
Love one another as I have loved you,
That’s the command — faithful and true.
Not loud religion, not empty show,
But walking the truth wherever you go.
Poor in spirit, gentle in heart,
That’s how the Kingdom is set apart.
No crown of gold from the world’s acclaim,
But a crown of glory in Yah’s great Name.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, follow me I’m ’bout to spread the Word,
From Friday sunset to Saturday sunset — Shalom heard.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, rest deeper than sleep,
Promises kept, His Word complete.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, step out of the race,
Enter His rest, enter His grace.
Thank Yah it’s Friday, forever I’ll say,
Teach me, O Yah, to live this way.
From sunset… to sunset…
Set apart… holy time…
Shabbat Shalom.
